reference_details.description: Provisional GMD PME regression baseline for the static_coulomb case. This is not an independent scientific reference; the independent external PME reference is validation/pme_external/.
reference_details.units: GMD internal units: eV, Angstrom, elementary charge

regenerated.reason: Three PME reciprocal-force defects were corrected: missing B-spline orders below 4, which zeroed every derivative weight and so removed the reciprocal force entirely; wrong order-6 quintic polynomials on [2,3), [3,4) and [4,5); and a missing K1*K2*K3 factor in the force interpolation. The superseded baseline recorded a reciprocal force of zero, so its stored forces were the real-space term alone.
regenerated.generated_at_commit_subject: fix: correct PME B-splines and reciprocal forces
regenerated.generated_at_commit_note: The numeric energy and force rows in this file were introduced by that commit, which is also the commit that corrected the PME force path. This provenance block was added afterwards and changes no value.
regenerated.generated_file_note: gmd_validate resolves charges.xyz and pme.run relative to the working directory and writes the JSON to the path given after --json. Nothing is written into the source tree; validation/static_coulomb/pme.json does not exist and is not produced.
regenerated.alternative_procedure_note: This wrapper copies the same inputs into <work-root>/static_coulomb and runs the same gmd_validate invocation, writing <work-root>/static_coulomb/pme.json. It then COMPARES that file against this baseline and exits non-zero when they differ, so while the previous baseline was still in place it reported failure even though the result file it needed had already been written correctly. Read the result out of <work-root>/static_coulomb/pme.json; a non-zero exit status from the wrapper does not mean generation failed.
regenerated.analytic_ewald_comparison: reference_ewald.json in this directory is an independent analytic periodic Ewald reference. The regenerated forces sit 8.19e-4 from it, which is the expected PME mesh error at grid 16^3, order 4, alpha 0.3; the superseded forces sat 8.90e-2 from it, roughly 94 percent of the force missing. This corroborates the regenerated values but does NOT make them an independent reference: they are still GMD output, and PME and Ewald are different approximations of the same sum.
regenerated.energy_unchanged_note: The stored energies are bit-identical to the superseded baseline. The defects were confined to the force interpolation path, which is why an energy-only regression never detected any of them.
regenerated.not_an_external_reference: WARNING: these values are generated by GMD itself. They are a regression baseline only, and remain one. No external engine was run for THIS case. Do not cite it as cross-code validation of PME. The independent external reference for PME is validation/pme_external/, which compares GMD against OpenMM 8.6.0 PME and LAMMPS 22 Jul 2025 PPPM on a separate Coulomb-only fixture; cite that instead.
